cpu.vt_x_note: Measured 2026-10-23 from Win32_Processor.VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled: VT-x is present in the CPU but DISABLED in firmware. Consequence for PRD 2.2-1: WHPX cannot be used on this host, so -accel tcg is not a preference but the only option. Not yet confirmed by reading CPUID inside the real UEFI shell (tests/acceptance/test_real_boot_edk2.py reaches one) -- the OS-reported firmware flag is what this record rests on.
